lines.text: The psalmist says he has done what is just and right and asks not to be left to his oppressors.
His eyes fail looking for the LORD's salvation, and he asks the LORD to deal with him according to loving devotion.
The psalmist loves the LORD's commandments more than the finest linen and hates every false way.
The unfolding of God's words gives light to the proud, and the psalmist pants, longing for the LORD's commandments.
Trouble and distress have found the psalmist, but the LORD's commandments are his delight, and he asks for understanding that he may live.
